title: Honoring the American History of the Great Lakes and Renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America

enrichment.summary: This executive order renames Lake Ontario as Lake America to honor the American history and contributions related to the Great Lakes. It directs the Secretary of the Interior and the Board on Geographic Names to update official maps and records to reflect this change within 30 days.
potential_concerns: Renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America may create diplomatic tensions and complicate cross-border cooperation with Canadian provincial and federal authorities, negatively impacting citizens of Canada and cross-border trade reliant on the Great Lakes-St. Lawrence Seaway system.

Maritime port workers and transportation workers may face confusion or operational disruptions during the transitional period of updating maps, contracts, and shipping documents, potentially impacting commerce and job stability.

Manufacturing workers in Great Lakes states dependent on shipping bulk commodities like iron ore and coal could experience indirect economic impacts if renaming causes temporary logistics or regulatory challenges.

The order’s emphasis on American heritage and investment without recognizing Canadian contributions may exacerbate regional or international political sensitivities, undermining binational environmental and water infrastructure initiatives.
